papers.title: Survey of Surveys Data Release 3. Homogenised stellar parameters across nine spectroscopic surveys
papers.comment: Submitted to A&A. 20 pages, 17 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary: Machine-learning regression homogenises effective temperatures, surface gravities, and metallicities across nine spectroscopic surveys, producing a 10.13-million-star catalogue validated on benchmark stars.

papers.title: MP-DualNet: A Dual-Branch Deep Learning Approach for Magnetopause Boundary Detection Using Simulated SXI Images
papers.summary: Dual-branch deep learning detects and segments the magnetopause in simulated SMILE soft X-ray images, reaching >0.94 classification accuracy and >0.97 IoU.

papers.title: MapHub: Daily Relevance Heatmaps of New arXiv Preprints for a Research Community
papers.comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, matches version accepted for publication
papers.summary: MapHub uses an LLM to score each day's arXiv submissions against researcher portfolios and publishes relevance heatmaps, outperforming text matching.

papers.title: A Machine Learning Approach to Coupling Photoionization & Multi-Frequency Radiation Hydrodynamics
papers.summary: Random-forest emulators trained on XSTAR outputs replace direct photoionization calculations in Athena++ radiation-hydrodynamic simulations of line-driven winds.
